findings.claim: Idempotent resolve-command retries return the stored receipt before re-authorizing access to the target case.
findings.evidence: In `aso.resolve_administering_entity_command`, the existing-command branch selects from `aso.administering_entity_resolution_commands` and `RETURN original.result;` before the later `PERFORM aso.require_case(target_case, 'resolve_administering_entity');`; the acceptance criteria require scope/authority refusal when a caller is foreign, stale, or lacks capability without publishing protected data.
findings.suggested_fix: Call `aso.require_case(target_case, 'resolve_administering_entity')` before returning any existing command result, and keep the command-conflict comparison after the target-case authorization succeeds.
